name: Brussels Big Cubes Open 2023
information:
This is a twin competition together with [Brussels Blind Open 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BrusselsBlindOpen2023). 
**You cannot register for both competitions. **

Note 1: As the events are quite specific, we do not recommend you attend this competition as your first competition. There are no 3x3, 2x2, skewb, pyraminx, ... events.

Note 2: As this competition is a twin competition with Brussels Blind Open, you might be asked to help scramble and judge (mostly for multi blind) for this competition as well.
